newsitem.title: USA: Host Funding in partnership to buy hotels.
newsitem.headline: Host Funding in partnership to buy hotels.

text.p: Host Funding Inc said it has signed a letter of intent with an undisclosed partner to buy four hotels valued at $50 million.
Host Funding will initially own 24 percent of the partnership, a company spokesman said. He said the partnership plans to buy two Holiday Inns, a Courtyard by Marriott hotel and a Hilton hotel.
The franchises, which are located in the Midwest and Southwest of the U.S., are budgeted to earn $22 million in revenues this year, a company statement said.

The spokesman said the company expects to close the deal at the end of September. He added the deal is contingent upon definite agreements with the hotels' owners, third-party lessees and managers, and Host completing its due diligence.

Host Funding is a real estate investment trust that currently owns 10 hotels in seven states, the company said. It posted a first-quarter net loss of $238,866 compared with a loss of $89,870 over the same period a year earlier.
